target_applications: hospitals/clinics, senior & supported living, airports, retail, hotels/restaurants, museums; social interaction + light logistics

base_type.value: ballbot (balances on a sphere driven by 3 omnidirectional wheels; sensor ring base added 2025)

dof_per_arm.source: n/a (not disclosed; The Robot Report cited 22 actuators total)

torso_lift.value: fixed torso on ballbot base (no lift column); can pull trolleys up to ~15 kg via handle

actuators.value: maxon ECi 40 brushless + planetary gearboxes (ball drive); maxon ECX Torque 22 mm brushless (other axes)

end_effector.value: 2 hands with opposable thumbs; grasps standardized 'connected handles'/runes attached to objects; vendor claims 97% grasp success

media_at_flange.value: n/a (no tool changer; connected-handle system instead)

sensors_head.value: 2 RGBD cameras, 2 infrared cameras, 4 microphones; projected-screen face; face/voice recognition

sensors_wrist_hand.value: IMUs in both hands; 6-axis torque sensor

sensors_base.value: 12 ToF cameras (8x8 px), 6 ultrasound sensors, base IMU; sensor-embedded ring around ball (2025) for 360-degree obstacle detection; no lidar disclosed

compute.value: 2 processing units (2 CPUs + 2 GPUs); Nvidia Jetson-class per press; hybrid edge/cloud architecture

software_stack.value: proprietary; no-code 'If This Then That' Natural Interaction Programming; LLM support (ChatGPT, Llama), multimodal VLA models, ~50 languages; Explorer Suite (2025); fleet mgmt planned early 2027; Dev Program for researchers

safety_compliance.value: no ISO 13482 / ISO 10218 / UL certification publicly claimed; CE status undisclosed; compliant arms/base, protected joints, e-stop, 360-degree sensing, LED signaling, low speed, GDPR-compliant face tracking

price.value: ~EUR 50,000 purchase + several hundred EUR/month subscription (2026); earlier target EUR 30k; ~USD 40k cited at CES

availability.value: shipping; direct in France + deployment partners in USA, Germany, Italy, Japan (Kanematsu/Nagakura), Peru, Saudi Arabia; order via contact form

deployment_evidence.value: ISIR Sorbonne (first delivery Jul 2024); AP-HP incl. Broca & Annie Girardot pilots; Institut du Cancer de Montpellier pediatric radiotherapy; Lyon-Saint Exupery Airport (VINCI, Nov-Dec 2025); APREH 11-robot deal; Mather Institute (IL) & Live Oak (San Jose) US pilots; iREX 2025 Japan debut; production 'in the dozens' as of Mar 2026, 250,000 usage minutes/yr

notes: Spec discrepancies: 2024 vendor sheet said ~1.30 m / ~30 kg (prototype) vs 123 cm / 26 kg in 2025 Kanematsu release (production robot); vendor claims 28 DoF vs 22 actuators cited by The Robot Report. Funding: EUR 15M seed Feb 2022 (business angels, largest French robotics seed); PitchBook lists $35.6M total raised (unverified breakdown); losses EUR 4.42M (2023) / EUR 10.1M (2024). CES-2025 goal of 100 robots in 2025 appears missed (production 'in dozens' as of Mar 2026). Vendor autonomy roadmap: self-recharging Q4 2026, supervision/fleet tooling early 2027, full autonomy Q1 2027.
